author: gustavopercoski
quote: Honestly, a romance storyline in a heist game makes absolutely no sense, mixing romance into the game just doesn't work. The graphics in the ads seemed better, but in-game it's not as nice and the game is full of bugs.

author: gustavopercoski
quote: The game is very well made and beautiful, it looks like a work of art. The experience is like playing a brand new Nintendo game, I really enjoyed it.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
